title: SVG logo
summary: The brand's own SVG logo draws on: outlines trace in the accent, shapes fill from their centre, a glint passes and the name lands beside it.

params.name: background
params.description: a background id from the registry; empty uses the brand's first

params.name: name
params.description: the name beside the mark; empty takes the brand's name, 'none' for the mark alone

params.name: format
params.description: output size; the layout recomposes for each

usage:
npx paper-motion add svg-logo --name my-svg-logo
# edit CONFIG in pieces/my-svg-logo/scene.html, then:
npx paper-motion render pieces/my-svg-logo/scene.html --motion-blur 5
notes: Wired to the brand folder: needs brand/tokens.json (a palette and a font pair work) and, for the field, a shader-set entry.
Recomposes for 16:9, 9:16 and 1:1: set `format` and the layout and camera follow.
when: a logo sting from your own SVG
